 Updated: 6:11 PM CST Nov 3, 2026 Editorial Standards ⓘ Andy Kendeigh Sports Director Sean Callahan Big Red Zone Insider OMAHA, Neb. — This week on Big Red Zone Rundown, Andy Kendeigh and Sean Callahan look back at Saturday's disappointing loss to Washington and Matt Rhule's passionate news conference on Monday. 
 Andy and Sean also look ahead to Friday night's matchup with Illinois in Champaign.
